stateRecords.meaning: A durable job acceptance and request identity exist, but no executing attempt is currently observed; a claimed fenced lease before dispatch may coexist with QUEUED.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: One fenced worker lease owns this attempt before dispatch intent; expiry or fence loss prevents later writes from this attempt.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: An authorized upload session accepts only contiguous, bounded chunks for its exact upload identity; partial bytes are not a registered or available artifact version.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A tenant-scoped session record and protected reconnect-token reference exist; no live provider connection or accepted frame is implied.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: The claimant supplied an assertion only; it is not a verified license or permission and cannot authorize a protected use.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A named authority is evaluating exact declared scope; rights-dependent effects remain blocked until a scoped decision is recorded.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: An authorized source verified only the identified scope, evidence, territory, and validity; the decision does not authorize unlisted uses.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: Current evidence or policy permits a narrower scope; prohibited use remains blocked and the restriction reason is retained.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: The authority rejected the asserted scope; the rejected assertion cannot authorize use, while new evidence requires a new review.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A prior scoped verification was revoked; new work is blocked and in-flight effects require the relevant authority’s reconciliation.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: The declared verification validity elapsed; new rights-dependent work is blocked until current evidence is reviewed.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: Consent is only a recorded request and has no processing authority before trusted verification.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: Trusted authority verified consent for the exact tenant, principal, purpose, region, and validity; recheck those dimensions at each effect boundary.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: Trusted consent authority recorded revocation; new work is blocked at the next enforcement boundary and in-flight effects require separate reconciliation, without implying automatic termination.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: Consent validity elapsed; new consent-dependent work is blocked until a current trusted authority decision is recorded.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A newer authoritative consent replaces this record; the superseded record cannot be reactivated or used for new work.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; legal/contract authority remains external; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: The requester is preparing a review for one exact immutable version and purpose; no reviewer assignment or decision exists.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A delivery intent exists without preparation, dispatch, or external destination effect.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: No version-bound assessment result or explicit abstention has been recorded.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: The project container is open for current-authority reads and versioned changes; this status does not itself grant membership or imply an empty or populated revision.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: A mutable candidate revision is bound to its exact parent head and remains noncanonical until a guarded compare-and-set commit succeeds.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN

stateRecords.meaning: An invitation is pending acceptance and confers no project access before the membership authority activates it.
stateRecords.status: OWNER_DEFINED_DEFINITION_ONLY; independent-review-open; runtime-observation-UNKNOWN
